resume.headline: Data engineer building Airflow and Spark pipelines

bullets.text: Migrated the nightly orders pipeline from cron to Airflow and Spark, cutting runtime from 6 hours to 45 minutes
Built a Superset data-quality dashboard on the customer data platform (CDP) used by 3 teams
Trained a machine learning (ML) churn model in Python with scikit-learn, reaching AUC 0.83 on holdout

paragraphs: I moved a nightly orders pipeline from cron to Airflow and cut its runtime from 6 hours to 45 minutes, the kind of work your data team describes.

At Acme the pipeline handles 40 million rows per day across 12 source systems, and failures dropped 80% after the move. I also built a Superset dashboard that caught 2 schema regressions before release.
Your Customer Data Platform is the center of the role, and I have built on one before. Happy to walk through any of this in more detail.

notes_for_user: Kubernetes and Terraform are not in your library, so I left them out.
